answer: Proof of Personhood protocols utilize cryptographic attestations to ensure one identity per biological entity, preventing Sybil agents from exploiting the system. Like a karst topography eroding under pressure, the cost of forging unique human signatures remains prohibitive. If an attacker tries to whisper fake data into the network, the protocol detects the statistical anomaly. At the dawn of decentralized AI, these mechanisms impose a significant computational and capital cost per node.
